params.name: package
params.description: The name of the package. For scoped packages, use URL encoding (e.g., @scope%2Fpackage).

params.name: tarball
params.description: The tarball filename, typically in the format {package}-{version}.tgz.

items.docs: Downloads the tarball archive for a specific version of a package. The tarball filename is typically in the format {package}-{version}.tgz. This endpoint is used by the npm CLI during package installation.
